records.jp: はぁ～……
records.en_original: *Sigh*...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*...
records.en: *Sigh*...

records.jp: （……疲れた。テレビ点けよう）
records.en_original: (I'm tired... I wonder what's on TV.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm tired... I wonder what's on TV.)
records.en: (Kirara is tired... She will turn on the television.)

records.jp: （あ、アニメやってる。まぁ、いっかこれで）
records.en_original: (Oh, it's some anime... Might as well check it out.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh, it's some anime... Might as well check it out.)
records.en: (Oh, it's some anime... Might as well check it out.)

records.jp: 帰る
records.en_original: Goodbye.
records.en_auxiliary: Goodbye.
records.en: Kirara is leaving.

records.jp: 無理！　ほんと無理！<CR>こんなの見られたら……私耐えられない！
records.en_original: No! I can't do it! I can't bear to see any more!
records.en_auxiliary: No! I can't do it! I can't bear to see any more!
records.en: No! I can't! I really can't!<CR>If everyone sees this... I won't survive it!

records.jp: みんなこの苦しみを味わってきたんだよ
records.en_original: Everyone else has suffered through this, you know.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone else has suffered through this, you know.
records.en: Everyone else has suffered through this, you know.

records.jp: ……一人だけ逃げるつもり？
records.en_original: Are you really going to be the only one to run away?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you really going to be the only one to run away?
records.en: Are you really going to be the only one to run away?

records.jp: ……くっ
records.en_original: Grr...
records.en_auxiliary: Grr...
records.en: Grr...

records.jp: なにこれ……
records.en_original: What is this...?
records.en_auxiliary: What is this...?
records.en: What is this...?

records.jp: （アニメなんて、子ども向けの<CR>娯楽じゃなかったの……？）
records.en_original: (I thought anime was just for kids...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I thought anime was just for kids...)
records.en: (Was anime not supposed to be<CR>entertainment for children...?)

records.jp: （こんなにも心がゆさぶられて<CR>苦しくて楽しくなるものだったなんて）
records.en_original: (I didn't realize it was so moving, so heart-wrenching, so...fun.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I didn't realize it was so moving, so heart-wrenching, so...fun.)
records.en: (I never knew something could shake Kirara's heart so deeply<CR>and feel so painful yet so enjoyable.)

records.jp: （とりあえず来週も予約しよう。<CR>……いや、リアタイしよう）
records.en_original: (I should record next week's episode. ...No, I wanna watch it when it airs.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I should record next week's episode. ...No, I wanna watch it when it airs.)
records.en: (For now, Kirara will record next week's episode.<CR>...No. Kirara will watch it live.)

records.jp: あー、目覚めちゃったんだねえ
records.en_original: Ahh. That was your awakening.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh. That was your awakening.
records.en: Ah, so that was Kirara's awakening.

records.jp: へー、宮内さんがね
records.en_original: I'd never think that Rena would...
records.en_auxiliary: I'd never think that Rena would...
records.en: So Miyauchi-san was like that too, huh?

records.jp: ちょっと意外です
records.en_original: I am somewhat surprised.
records.en_auxiliary: I am somewhat surprised.
records.en: I am somewhat surprised.

records.jp: （最終回、か）
records.en_original: (That was the last episode...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That was the last episode...)
records.en: (That was the last episode...)

records.jp: （これだけが唯一の楽しみだったのに。<CR>私、明日からどうやって生きればいいの……）
records.en_original: (This was the only thing that kept me going... What do I have to live for now?)
records.en_auxiliary: (This was the only thing that kept me going... What do I have to live for now?)
records.en: (This was Kirara's one and only pleasure.<CR>How is Kirara supposed to live from tomorrow on...?)

records.jp: （とりあえずネットで最終回の感想を……<CR>あ、これ……ファンアート？）
records.en_original: (Maybe I'll look up some discussions of the finale online... Oh, what is this? Fan art...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Maybe I'll look up some discussions of the finale online... Oh, what is this? Fan art...?)
records.en: (For now, Kirara will look up reactions to the finale online...<CR>Oh, is this... fan art?)

records.jp: （……なるほど。こうやって創作していけば<CR>あの子たちは私の中で永遠に生き続けるのか）
records.en_original: (I see... By drawing the characters, I can keep them alive in my heart forever...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I see... By drawing the characters, I can keep them alive in my heart forever...)
records.en: (I see. By creating things like this,<CR>those girls can live forever inside Kirara.)

records.jp: ……よし。明日ペンタブとかいうの、見に行ってみよう
records.en_original: All right. I'm going to buy a tablet tomorrow.
records.en_auxiliary: All right. I'm going to buy a tablet tomorrow.
records.en: ...All right. Tomorrow Kirara will go look at one of those pen tablets.

records.jp: お、思ったよりハマったんだね……
records.en_original: Wow, you got even more into anime than you expected, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, you got even more into anime than you expected, huh?
records.en: Wow, you got even more into anime than you expected, huh?

records.jp: ……そうだよ<CR>
records.en_original: ...Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah.
records.en: ...That is right.<CR>

records.jp: 私はオタクだよ！
records.en_original: I am a nerd, and proud of it!
records.en_auxiliary: I am a nerd, and proud of it!
records.en: Kirara is an otaku!

records.jp: しかも同人誌まで出しちゃってるような<CR>ゴリゴリのオタクだよ！
records.en_original: I'm such a nerd that I even draw my own comics!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm such a nerd that I even draw my own comics!
records.en: A hardcore otaku who even publishes doujinshi!<CR>That is what Kirara is!

records.jp: これで満足！？
records.en_original: Happy now?!
records.en_auxiliary: Happy now?!
records.en: Happy now?!

records.jp: う、うん。大満足だよ。<CR>だから落ち着いて
records.en_original: Y-yeah, very. Now just calm down, okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah, very. Now just calm down, okay?
records.en: Y-yes. Completely satisfied.<CR>So please calm down.

records.jp: 今時そんな恥ずかしがるようなことじゃないから
records.en_original: It's not even that embarrassing these days.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not even that embarrassing these days.
records.en: It's not even that embarrassing these days.

records.jp: こんなに自暴自棄になるなんて、<CR>よっぽど触れてほしくなかったんだろうね
records.en_original: For her to get so worked up... She probably really didn't want us to see this.
records.en_auxiliary: For her to get so worked up... She probably really didn't want us to see this.
records.en: For her to become this desperate,<CR>she must have truly wanted us to leave this alone.

records.jp: この話題についてはそっとしておきましょうか
records.en_original: Maybe we should wrap up this discussion.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe we should wrap up this discussion.
records.en: Maybe we should wrap up this discussion.

records.jp: （そういえば屋上部室のパソコンで見た絵って<CR>もしかして……そういうことか）
records.en_original: (Ah... So that's what the drawing I saw on the computer in the rooftop storage room was.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ah... So that's what the drawing I saw on the computer in the rooftop storage room was.)
records.en: (Come to think of it, the picture on the computer<CR>in the Rooftop Clubroom... So that's what it was.)
